_about: Runner B (ARM64 Wine 11.18 + FEX, no Rosetta) build inputs, read by scripts/build-wine-arm64.sh and scripts/assemble-runner-b.sh with plutil. Rule 4: every input pinned by SHA-256. A sha256 of TODO-PIN makes the scripts refuse to run. Kinds: url = downloaded into downloads/ and verified; repo = a file committed here, verified before use. Keys must not contain dots (plutil key paths).
_highball: gauthierpiarrette/highball-engine at ac5cc83bb7d90b8fcca8e60a4a37fce2b9ee1d81 (main, 2026-10-06). Local clone and GitHub blob shas compared 2026-10-09: identical.

wine.source: Highball inputs-arm64.json (ac5cc83). Single source: WineHQ publishes no checksum list. After the first fetch, diff once against tag wine-11.18 (tag object ccf4f04c, commit 7b3fff76f101, 2026-09-18).

llvm-mingw.source: Highball inputs-arm64.json; equals the GitHub release asset digest (gh api, 2026-10-09).

hangover-dlls.source: Highball inputs-arm64.json; equals the GitHub release asset digest (gh api, 2026-10-09). FEX 2608 as libarm64ecfex.dll / libwow64fex.dll, MIT.

highball-0003.source: Highball patches-arm64/0003 at ac5cc83 (byte-identical to patches/0003, which Runner A already carries). LGPL-2.1-or-later.

runner-b-0020.source: Ours, written against wine-11.18 loader/main.c and dlls/ntdll/unix/loader.c (read from tag wine-11.18 via the wine-mirror GitHub API). LGPL-2.1-or-later like the files it changes.

runner-b-0021.source: Ours (B2): port of leonseemann/NotProton winemac-patch/dxmt_export.c (d56e28e0, file sha256 66056ac5..., GPL-3, Wine 11.15) to the wine-11.18 winemac API; exports macdrv_functions for DXMT winemetal.so (slots 1, 2, 6, 7, 8 + client_cocoa_view). GPL-3 for dxmt_export.c, so winemac.so is GPL-3 as a whole.

runner-b-0022.source: Ours (B3): port of patches/local/0001 and 0003 (Valve proton_11.0 ntdll steamclient series, LGPL-2.1-or-later) to wine-11.18; on the arm64 host the x86 trampolines are written through NtProtectVirtualMemory instead of mprotect(RWX).

runner-b-0023.source: Ours (B3): port of patches/local/0002 to wine-11.18 (configure registration only; 11.18 makedep parses .cpp).

fexunixlib-darwin.source: Highball fex/fexunixlib_darwin.cpp at ac5cc83, kept unchanged; our kr trace is runner-b/fex/0001-fexunixlib-trace-kr.patch. MIT (after FEX Source/Windows/UnixLib); FEX's licence text is runner-b/fex/LICENSE.FEX.

fexunixlib-trace.source: Ours: prints the kern_return_t of thread_set_x86_64_compat ("TSOControl 1 kr=0") behind FEXUNIX_TRACE. Test-compiled for arm64 against the macOS 27 CLT SDK.

fexunixlib-tso-threads.source: Ours: thread_set_x86_64_compat is per thread on macOS and FEX asks once, so a pthread introspection hook enables hardware TSO on every thread started after FEX's request. Applied after 0001. Verified with tsoprobe x64 + i386: 0 violations (research/RUNNER-B-TSO.md).

moltenvk.source: Runner A's pin (scripts/build-deps.sh); equals the GitHub release digest. The dylib is universal (x86_64 arm64, checked with lipo on the local copy).

crossover-sources.source: Runner A's pin (scripts/prepare-wine-src.sh). Runner B uses only sources/gmp (inside gnutls), gnutls and freetype from it, for build-deps.sh.

_dxmt: B2 renderer, read by scripts/build-dxmt-arm64.sh. 3Shain/dxmt pinned at 7c8dee1 (PR #209 Ci/arm64x tip, merged 2026-09-17; tree c273b79a). GitHub tarballs carry no published digest, so the sha256s below were taken by `scripts/build-dxmt-arm64.sh pin` (2026-10-10) after every file matched the commit's git tree (gh api), as rule 4 asks. Submodule external/nvapi (NVIDIA/nvapi d08488f) is only needed with -Denable_nvapi and is not pinned.

dxmt.source: github.com/3Shain/dxmt, LGPL-2.1-or-later (LICENSE at 7c8dee1; LICENSE.OLD keeps the older notice). 379 blobs, 3,941,928 bytes uncompressed (gh api git tree, 2026-10-10); pinned 2026-10-10 by `build-dxmt-arm64.sh pin`: all 379 files matched the git tree of 7c8dee1 (gh api).

dxmt-directx-headers.source: DXMT submodule include/native/directx at 7c8dee1 (gitlink 9df86f2, 2022-08-22). 66 blobs, 4,140,678 bytes uncompressed (gh api); pinned 2026-10-10 by `build-dxmt-arm64.sh pin`: all 66 files matched the git tree of 9df86f2 (gh api). Required: DXMT's meson.build stops without include/native/directx/d3d11.h.

llvm-project-15.source: LLVM 15.0.7 (DXMT docs/DEVELOPMENT.md: exact major 15; DXMT CI LLVM_VERSION llvmorg-15.0.7). The release asset predates GitHub digests (gh api: none); sha256 from two independent packagers that agree: Homebrew llvm@15 formula (brew info --json=v2) and MacPorts lang/llvm-15 Portfile (also size 110936452 = the GitHub asset size). Upstream .sig exists (GPG). Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception. Only llvm/, cmake/ and third-party/ are extracted.

dxmt-ci-prebuilt.name: dxmt-7c8dee1c2d73415301ceb7d1fa810861cef4cd67
dxmt-ci-prebuilt.source: Optional shortcut, not the build route: DXMT's own CI package job for push run 35187190160 at 7c8dee1 (zip holding dxmt-<sha>.tar.gz: gcc x86_64 + gcc x86 + clang arm64ec builds; arm64ec half linked against 3Shain's wine-11.2 tree, not ours). sha256 is GitHub's artifact digest (gh api .../artifacts, 2026-10-10). Expires with the run; never use in CI.

wine-mono-x86.source: wine-11.18 dlls/appwiz.cpl/addons.c MONO_VERSION 11.3.0 / MONO_SHA (x86); equals the madewokherd/wine-mono release digest.

wine-mono-arm64.source: wine-11.18 dlls/appwiz.cpl/addons.c MONO_SHA (__aarch64__); equals the madewokherd/wine-mono release digest.

wine-gecko-x86.source: Runner A's pin; equals wine-11.18 addons.c GECKO_SHA (i386).

wine-gecko-x86_64.source: Runner A's pin; equals wine-11.18 addons.c GECKO_SHA (x86_64).

_kosmickrisp: Runner B DX12 (HANDOFF item 8): KosmicKrisp from Mesa main ce576c29 plus fxgl/steamac ed06800b host/kosmickrisp/patches 0001-0040 (Apache-2.0), built by scripts/build-kosmickrisp.sh; packaged with vkd3d-proton and DXVK by scripts/package-runner-b-dx12.sh. Fetched 2026-10-10 with the user's OK.

mesa-kosmickrisp.source: MESA_COMMIT of steamac host/kosmickrisp/build.sh at ed06800b. GitLab archive; single source, pinned on first fetch.

kosmickrisp-patches.source: 40 patch files in downloads/kosmickrisp-patches-ed06800b/; this sha pins the per-file sha256 list, which build-kosmickrisp.sh checks.

vkd3d-proton.source: GitHub release v3.0.1 (2026-05-06); equals the asset digest. x64/x86 PE only; runs under FEX on Runner B.

dxvk.source: GitHub release v3.1.1 (2026-09-15); equals the asset digest (gh api, 2026-10-10). x64/x86 PE; dxgi.dll pairs with vkd3d-proton on Runner B.
